summary.en: An overly strict man is accused of murdering a woman. Is it murder or is it self-defense? Conan must investigate and figure out the truth. Victim: Misa Katayama Cause of death: Blunt-force trauma Iwao Iwata accidently killed a woman named Misa Katayama who attempt to kill him in self-defense. Is this the truth? Or there is there something hidden?
